community.name: descarteria
community.title: descarteria
community.description:
Hi!

I've made this community to post my thoughts, things I like, and other stuff related to my interests or things that I create. Think of it as my personal brain-dump, and a place for you guys to hang out and interact with me.

<< RULEBOOK >>

1. What goes here (The Vibe)
This is a space for life thoughts, music, art, and all kinds of creative work. Feel free to share your own creations, discuss topics I post about, or just drop random reflections.

2. Keep it Ecchi, NOT HARD R34 (NSFW Policy)
Slightly spicy or suggestive content (ecchi) is fine from time to time, depending on the context. However, hardcore porn, explicit nudity, and harcore Rule 34 are strictly forbidden. If you're not sure where the line is—don't post it.

3. Respect the personal vibe
Since this place includes personal thoughts and creative work, don't be a jerk. Constructive criticism is welcome, toxic behavior, mocking, or drama is not.

4. Don't hijack the space
It's cool to share your stuff, but remember this community revolves around our shared interests. No spamming, unsolicited self-promotion, or flooding the feed.

5. Platform Rules apply
Use common sense and follow the platform's Terms of Service so this place doesn't get banned.

community.name: Dergism
community.title: Dergism
community.description:
Dergism is a statist approach to establishing socialist and communist rule. The aim is to spread awareness of how intensification of class struggle transfers wealth out of private capital and into the security arms of the state. The Ethiopian Revolution proved that when the state gets big enough, capital will be crushed under its weight.

No subject is off-limits to post here, as any post can draw attention to theoretical conversation. If you're an anarchist, expect a debate.

"The Derg was established on 21 June 1974 as the Coordinating Committee of the Armed Forces, Police and Territorial Army, by junior and mid-level officers of the Imperial Ethiopian Army and members of the police."

(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Derg)

“As the state arose from the need to keep class antagonisms in check, **but also arose in the thick of the fight between the classes,** it is normally the state of the most powerful, economically ruling class, which by its means becomes also the politically ruling class, and so acquires new means of holding down and exploiting the oppressed class. The ancient state was, above all, the state of the slave-owners for holding down the slaves, just as the feudal state was the organ of the nobility for holding down the peasant serfs and bondsmen, and the modern representative state is the instrument for exploiting wage-labor by capital. **Exceptional periods, however, occur when the warring classes are so nearly equal in forces that the state power, as apparent mediator, acquires for the moment a certain independence in relation to both.**”

“It [the public power] **grows stronger,** however, in proportion as class antagonisms within the state become more acute, and as adjacent states become larger and more populous."

(Both quotes F. Engels, The Origin of the Family, Private Property, and the State – https://www.marxists.org/archive/marx/works/1884/origin-family/ch09.htm. The brackets are Lenin’s.)
